**Finding submitted — deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive clauses inspected:** §1.4 (p0008–p0009, the only grant of rights to us — access to and right to use HDI's system, software and Content administration tools), §6.1/6.2 (Marks licence, which runs *to* HDI and so is out of scope for this rule), §10.3 Assignment (p0063), plus the preamble definition of "Company" (p0002), which names only The Deerskin Companies, Inc.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the grant reaches "the Company" alone, with no affiliate coverage and no mechanism to add affiliates. It is not revocable at HDI's discretion, so it is short of, but not in, walk-away territory.
- **Already met:** successor transfer — §10.3 makes the Agreement enforceable by the parties' successors and assigns without HDI consent, so no edit there (and no duplicate coverage under ASSIGN).
- **Change made:** one insert after p0009 permitting Company affiliates to exercise the §1.4 access and use rights on written notice, with a brief control parenthetical so "affiliates" is not left undefined. Preferred-level perpetual/irrevocable, contractor and uncured-breach elements were not pressed, consistent with taking the shortest complete fallback fix.
